subject.title: fix(codex): add WebSocket handshake timeout to app-server transport

question: Should Codex WebSocket connection setup use the existing `appServer.requestTimeoutMs` policy, or intentionally enforce a separate fixed 30-second handshake deadline?
rationale: Both choices prevent indefinite hangs, but they have different compatibility and operator-tuning behavior; repository policy requires explicit ownership of new fail-closed defaults.

options.title: Reuse existing timeout policy
options.body: Derive `handshakeTimeout` from the resolved app-server request timeout so connection setup follows the documented operator setting and default.

options.title: Keep fixed 30 seconds
options.body: Retain the constant only after adding direct transport proof and documenting that handshake setup has a separate non-configurable deadline.

recommendation.title: Reuse existing timeout policy
recommendation.body: Derive `handshakeTimeout` from the resolved app-server request timeout so connection setup follows the documented operator setting and default.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and landed the bundled Codex app-server transport and are the strongest history-backed owner for its timeout policy.
